v1.0.1-preview.13
- Updated to depend on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore 1.0.1-preview.13, which adds offline-first optimistic writes (opt-in via FirestoreBuilder.OptimisticWrites) and eliminates the proto-to-JSON round-trip on typed model conversion. The native gRPC transport's CreateWriteStreamAsync backs the offline-first Write stream flush path.

v1.0.1-preview.12
- Updated to depend on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore 1.0.1-preview.12, which fixes ObjectDisposedException on SemaphoreSlim.Release() during network disable and UnobservedTaskException from WebChannel receive-loop exceptions during concurrent disposal.
